# Backup Tools: References

Always prefer current vendor and project documentation for the exact versions in use. Re-verify links and
contents when updating this skill; record the date checked.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor and project (authoritative)

### Restic

- Documentation: https://restic.readthedocs.io/en/stable/
- Removing snapshots, prune, and append-only considerations (`--keep-within`):
  https://restic.readthedocs.io/en/stable/060_forget.html
- Repository backends and credentials (environment variables, B2, S3):
  https://restic.readthedocs.io/en/stable/030_preparing_a_new_repo.html
- Releases and security advisories: https://github.com/restic/restic/releases and
  https://github.com/restic/restic/security/advisories
- rest-server (port 8000, `--append-only`, `--private-repos`, TLS, htpasswd):
  https://github.com/restic/rest-server

### BorgBackup and Borgmatic

- Borg documentation (stable): https://borgbackup.readthedocs.io/en/stable/
- Append-only mode and hosting notes:
  https://borgbackup.readthedocs.io/en/stable/usage/notes.html
- `borg serve` (forced commands, `--append-only`, `--restrict-to-path`, `--restrict-to-repository`):
  https://borgbackup.readthedocs.io/en/stable/usage/serve.html
- Hosting repositories securely: https://borgbackup.readthedocs.io/en/stable/deployment/hosting-repositories.html
- Change log, including security notes: https://borgbackup.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changes.html
- Releases (1.4.x stable; 2.0 betas marked not for production at review):
  https://github.com/borgbackup/borg/releases
- Borgmatic documentation (passphrase handling, hooks): https://torsion.org/borgmatic/

### Veeam

- Community Edition (workload limit, supported platforms):
  https://www.veeam.com/products/free/backup-recovery.html
- Backup & Replication user guide, ports reference (version selector on the page):
  https://helpcenter.veeam.com/docs/vbr/userguide/used_ports.html?ver=13
- Hardened repository requirements and limitations:
  https://helpcenter.veeam.com/docs/vbr/userguide/hardened_repository_limitations.html?ver=13
- Build-by-build list of security fixes: https://www.veeam.com/kb3103
- Per-release vulnerability articles are published as Veeam KB entries; start from KB3103 above and the
  release notes for the installed build.
- Veeam Agent documentation is linked from the help center: https://helpcenter.veeam.com/

### Duplicati

- Server options (port 8200, interface binding, password, allowed hostnames, settings encryption key,
  TLS, pre-auth tokens): https://docs.duplicati.com/duplicati-programs/server
- Documentation home and release notes: https://docs.duplicati.com/

### Backblaze B2

- Application keys (master vs. standard keys, bucket and prefix restriction, capabilities, expiry):
  https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-application-keys
- Object Lock: https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-object-lock
- Enabling Object Lock on an existing bucket:
  https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-enable-object-lock-or-a-legal-hold-on-an-existing-bucket
- Lifecycle rules: https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-lifecycle-rules

### Wasabi

- Immutability, compliance, and object locking (mutually exclusive features; object lock at bucket
  creation): https://docs.wasabi.com/docs/immutability-compliance-and-object-locking
- Object lock with the Wasabi S3 API: https://docs.wasabi.com/apidocs/object-lock-with-the-wasabi-s3-api

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.
